{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of patient_id to confirm duplicates
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_count_summary = dup_counts.value_counts().sort_index()

print("Duplicate patient_id counts:")
print(dup_count_summary)

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check the arm and severity association
print(f"\nArm by severity cross-tabulation:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))

# Check the proportion of severe patients in each arm
arm_severity_prop = df.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)
print(f"\nProportion of severe patients in each arm:")
print(arm_severity_prop)

# Check the assay_batch unit issue
print(f"\nUnique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"\nDistribution of assay_batch: {df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check the sample_seq distribution per patient
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"\nMaximum sample_seq per patient: {sample_seq_max.value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
